additional_metadata.name: Trey Murphy III: 2+
additional_metadata.title: Trey Murphy III: 2+ combined steals and blocks
additional_metadata.rules_primary: If Trey Murphy III records 2+ combined steals and blocks in the New Orleans vs Oklahoma City Pro Basketball game originally scheduled for Nov 20, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
additional_metadata.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on the number of combined steals and blocks recorded by Trey Murphy III.

Important Information: This Contract is designated as protected. If the individual player enters the game during the first half of the game but does not enter the game after the conclusion of the first half, including any overtime period, this Contract resolves to the fair price prior to the opening tip of the game unless the player records the required number of combined steals and blocks, in which case this Contract settles based on actual statistics. If the player enters the game after the conclusion of the first half, this Contract settles based on actual statistics, regardless of first-half participation. Injury, an injury designation, or being ruled out is not required for protection.
